scope: Real HPRC Release 2 chromosome 19 haplotypes; not whole human genomes. Uniqueness is within the chromosome inputs, not genome-wide.
paper_relation: The paper includes chr19 scaling. This uses newer Release 2 assemblies and C++ 1.4.2, not its exact older scaffolded panel or C++ 1.1.1.
selection: Nested prefixes in sample ID order; one haplotype 1 per individual; unique chr19 alias and FAI record, length 40-90 Mb; 64 eligible records frozen before the eight-input benchmark

eligibility_screen.criterion: One haplotype 1 per distinct individual, lexicographic sample order; unique chromosome-19 alias and FAI record, length 40-90 Mb

extraction: Official FAI/GZI and assembly-specific UCSC aliases; HTTP Range BGZF blocks bound to ETag, CRC checked; extracted lengths, alphabet and FASTA SHA256 verified
cpp_execution: Single-threaded optimized core at two inputs; up to min(32,N-1) concurrent anchor partitions thereafter, upstream C++ anchor merger and minimum-length filter included in timing
rust_execution: Frozen previously fastest bacterial PGO executable; native 32 threads requested; no human-specific retraining or algorithm changes

optimization.rust: opt-level=3, native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit, PGO

hardware.storage: Local NVMe; plain FASTA input staging

timing: Tool wall time including graph/index/scan/merge/output. Download, staging, archival and validation excluded. Inputs warmed after sync. No download or compilation overlaps measured runs.
memory: Completed peak is max(GNU time maximum process RSS, 20 ms sampled process-tree RSS sum). Sampled failure RSS and lower-bound observations are labelled separately. Guard is a process-tree RSS budget, not total machine RAM.
validation: Every reported completed MUM checked for DNA, coordinates, contig boundaries and joint maximality; independent overlapping Aho-Corasick occurrence counting on both strands. This establishes validity of reported C++ matches, not a proof of completeness.
equality: No completed Rust human output exists; exact C++/Rust output agreement is unestablished. C++ self-comparison fields in raw harness files must not be interpreted as cross-tool agreement.

reference_bottleneck.evidence: 32 reference context files remained empty from construction to the late observation; source constructs them after read_reference and immediately before reference_contexts. This is phase evidence, not sampled stack profiling.
reference_bottleneck.interpretation: Repeated proto occurrences induce nested self-alignment work before parallel query scanning starts. Graph construction itself took about five seconds at k63.

main_series.rss_method: Kernel VmHWM sampled every 0.5 seconds; final zombie samples do not erase the previous high-water mark.

main_series.reason: C++ first exceeded the shared 48 GiB local memory limit; scaling stopped

rust.reason: Smallest-stage feasibility time budget exhausted; censored, not a completed runtime
rust.phase: Reference self-alignment context generation (worker 0 scratch files exist and are empty; query scan not reached)
rust.hypothesis: Nested fragment occurrence loops create pairwise repeat alignments; source inspection, not a sampled profiler attribution.

experimental_k100: Incomplete separate configuration: graph unitig joining did not advance its first bucket during >190 s observation and was stopped. No C++ result at k100; not part of the k63 comparison.
